metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened the .xcf file on Desktop by double-clicking. GIMP started loading but never completed rendering, stuck for all 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent can launch GIMP and attempt image manipulation operations via menus.
metadata.failure_analysis: GIMP load stalled before any image manipulation could be performed.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests GIMP's Scale Image feature as a self-contained sub-goal. The original image dimensions (1200x80 encoded in filename) allow computing the expected output size (600x40) without external ground truth.
metadata.explanation: Evaluator downloads scaled.png from Desktop and checks width=600, height=40 (half of 1200x80). Initial state has no scaled.png so evaluator returns 0.0. Returns 0.5 if only one dimension matches, 1.0 if both correct. llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves /home/user/Desktop/scaled.png from the VM using env.controller.get_file and PIL to extract pixel dimensions, returning {width, height, exists}.
Metric correctly checks both width==600 and height==40 (half of original 1200x80 encoded in the XCF filename), returning 1.0 only when both match.
Negative-control resistant: returns 0.0 when scaled.png does not exist (initial state has no such file).
Evaluator logic fully covers the instruction requirements: correct output path (Desktop/scaled.png), correct format (PNG), and correct scaled dimensions.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The 0.5 partial credit for a single-dimension match could allow a misleading partial score if the agent scales only one dimension. Consider requiring both dimensions to match for any positive score, or keeping 0.5 as an intentional partial-credit design.
